# JOGI Ayu AI — Clinical Knowledge & RAG Directory

> JOGI Ayu AI is an authenticated clinical Ayurveda and Panchakarma intelligence platform supervised by Dr. Devangi Jogal and Nilesh Jogal at Jogi Ayurved Hospital, Surat, Gujarat.

## Core Clinical Domains
- [Constipation & Gastrointestinal Therapeutics](https://jogiayurved.com/clinical/constipation): Diagnostic criteria, Pathyapathya guidelines, Koshta classification, and Panchakarma treatments.
- [Fatty Liver & Metabolic Wellness](https://jogiayurved.com/clinical/fatty-liver): SGPT/SGOT biomarker tracking, non-alcoholic fatty liver mitigation, and home herb formulations.
- [Parkinson's & Neurological Disorders](https://jogiayurved.com/clinical/kampavata): Kampavata protocols, mucuna pruriens (Kauncha), and specialized Basti regimens.
- [Cardiovascular & Arjuna Therapeutics](https://jogiayurved.com/clinical/cardio): Terminalia arjuna Kshirapaka, lipid management, and blood circulation balance.
- [Allergy, Sinus & Rhinitis](https://jogiayurved.com/clinical/pratishyaya): Chronic sinus management, Nasya procedures, Anu Taila, and Rasala administration.

## Key Formulations & Classical Sources
- [Panchsakar Churna](https://jogiayurved.com/herbs/panchsakar): Haritaki, Sonth, Fennel, Senna, Rock Salt.
- [Icchabhedi Ras](https://jogiayurved.com/herbs/icchabhedi-ras): Croton tiglium (Nepala) administration with cold water protocols.
- [Rasayan Churna](https://jogiayurved.com/herbs/rasayan-churna): Guduci, Gokshura, and Amalaki in equal ratios with unequal honey/ghee.
- [Swadishta Virechan Churna](https://jogiayurved.com/herbs/swadishta-virechan): Licorice, Senna, Fennel, Purified Sulphur, Sugar.
